headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty closed at eight-month highs amid a five-session rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: The NSE and BSE are closed today, 10 November 2026, in observance of the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
Trading in the equity segment will resume on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
The Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX) is scheduled to reopen for its evening session today.
GIFT Nifty is currently active and showing bullish signals, jumping 1% despite the domestic market closure.
whatHappening: In the last session, Sensex and Nifty extended their gains to reach their highest closing levels in over eight months.
India VIX has surged 68% over the past three weeks, indicating rising market volatility despite a 7% index rally.
Cochin Shipyard reported a 50% year-on-year decline in Q2 net profit to Rs 54 crore as margins contracted.
Brent crude oil prices have slipped below the $90 per barrel mark following a selloff triggered by geopolitical shifts.
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada after the Sensex and Nifty reached eight-month highs in the previous session. While benchmark indices have rallied 7% recently, the India VIX has jumped 68%, signaling increased volatility. Cochin Shipyard remains in focus following a 50% drop in quarterly profit despite declaring an interim dividend.
